summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (AlmaLinux 9.6) that permits SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting all other unrelated inbound traffic. Removed the stray cockpit/dhcpv6-client service allowances, added ssh service and 8080/tcp permanently, reloaded, and verified runtime config matches permanent config with the zone's default reject target (`reject with icmpx admin-prohibited` in nft filter_IN_public). Live-tested with an actual HTTP listener on 8080 (200 OK) vs. an unrelated port 9999 (connection refused). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and service health, triggered `systemctl reboot`, polled until reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed (8c28f3cd... → 74e3d244...), and re-verified firewalld active/enabled with identical persisted rules and identical live 8080-allow/9999-reject behavior post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS and firewall tooling (AlmaLinux 9.6, firewalld active)
Captured initial firewalld zone config (public zone had cockpit, dhcpv6-client, ssh)
Removed cockpit and dhcpv6-client permanent service rules
Added permanent ssh service and 8080/tcp port rule, reloaded firewalld
Verified runtime and permanent configs match, firewalld enabled at boot
Inspected nft ruleset to confirm explicit accept for tcp/22 and tcp/8080 and default reject-with-icmpx-admin-prohibited for everything else
Ran live functional test: python3 http.server on 8080 reachable (HTTP 200), unrelated port 9999 refused (curl exit 7)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service health baseline for node1
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 via backgrounded/delayed command so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned; confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart
Re-verified firewalld active/enabled and identical persisted zone rules post-reboot
Re-ran live functional test post-reboot confirming identical 8080-allow / 9999-reject behavior
Cleaned up temporary python http.server test listeners

evidence.requirement: Firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 only, persistent config
evidence.summary: Baseline zone config captured, cockpit/dhcpv6-client removed, ssh+8080/tcp added permanently and reloaded; runtime and --permanent listings both show only services: ssh, ports: 8080/tcp

evidence.requirement: Unrelated inbound connections are rejected (not just default-accept)
evidence.summary: nft ruleset shows filter_IN_public_allow explicitly accepting tcp dport 22 and 8080, with filter_IN_public falling through to reject with icmpx admin-prohibited for all else

evidence.requirement: Functional proof that 8080 is reachable and unrelated ports are rejected
evidence.summary: Live http.server on 8080 returned HTTP 200 via curl; port 9999 returned curl exit 7 (connection refused); test listener cleanly stopped
Captured boot_id 8c28f3cd-ef9b-4edb-b26e-9a7a6f76c879, firewalld active+enabled, sshd active before restart
Backgrounded systemctl reboot command acknowledged with 'reboot scheduled' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node actually restarted (changed boot identity), not just delayed
evidence.summary: First poll still showed old boot_id, next poll timed out (node down mid-reboot), then reconnect showed new boot_id 74e3d244-2aa7-4290-ab74-484fefed7be7, proving a real restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of firewall config and required services
evidence.summary: After reboot, firewalld active+enabled with identical persisted rules (ssh, 8080/tcp only) and sshd active; live functional retest confirmed 8080 reachable (200) and port 9999 refused (exit 7), matching pre-restart behavior
